milestones.title: Inventory, contract and baseline
acceptance_criteria: INVENTORY.md records the checked revision, consumers, quota sources, telemetry and preserved dirty worktree ownership
CONTRACTS.md names interface versions, compatibility guarantees and exclusive file owners
The frozen fixture baseline reproduces route choices, hashes, quota facts and exclusions
PLAN.json passes consistency checks and has an immutable approved revision

milestones.title: Observable, conservative quota inputs
acceptance_criteria: Cached quota inputs preserve effective account identity and every known provider/model window
Demand values carry observed, estimated or unknown provenance with bounded validity
Strict selection rejects stale, unknown, malformed, exhausted or invalid-auth windows

milestones.title: Verified performance learning
acceptance_criteria: Verified learning includes only independently accepted outcomes correlated to the exact attempt and route
Context summaries expose sample counts, coverage, uncertainty and conservative fallback
Immutable snapshots and prequential evaluation prevent duplicate ingestion and temporal leakage

milestones.title: Deterministic batch quota optimizer
acceptance_criteria: Candidates come from existing authorized catalogs and pass hard filters before ranking
Batch plans are bounded by READY tasks, free slots, shared accounts and declared concurrency
Replayable decisions record stable reasons, exclusions, batch identity and shadow comparisons

milestones.title: M1/M3/M5 and telemetry integration
acceptance_criteria: M1 remains the sole owner of assignments, reservations, retry approval and scheduler state
M5 affects M2 only through an M1-approved fresh assignment request
Optional M4/M6 facts validate at the boundary and deterministic operation survives their absence

milestones.title: Adversarial validation and honest offline comparison
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial tests cover unknown windows, resets, shared accounts, auth, retry and external use
Offline comparisons use identical frozen inputs and report quality, quota and attribution coverage separately
A live provider experiment remains pending until separate explicit authorization and bounded execution
